quotes.text: The imported AI summary reports that CalTransactionManager.commit() removes a failed transaction from undoStack and rethrows without automatically calling undoTransaction(). It also reports that cross-calendar moves add the destination before deleting the source, with pendingMoveCopies tracking partial copies and cleanup retries. This matters when explaining failure recovery: a rejected operation must not be described as proof that all provider changes were undone.
